name: Gaurav Kumar Yadav — Portfolio AI Assistant
description: An AI-powered chat assistant for the developer portfolio of Gaurav Kumar Yadav (ggauravky). The assistant answers questions about Gaurav's projects, skills, journey, services, and background. It is grounded in a curated knowledge base and does not hallucinate project details.

endpoints.name: AI Chat
endpoints.description: Ask a natural-language question about Gaurav Kumar Yadav's portfolio, projects, skills, services, or journey. Returns a structured JSON response.

message.description: Natural-language question for the portfolio AI assistant

sessionId.description: Optional session ID for multi-turn conversation context

example_request.message: What projects has Gaurav built with React and Node.js?

endpoints.name: Health Check
endpoints.description: Verify the AI chat endpoint is active before sending POST requests.

authentication.note: The AI chat endpoint is publicly accessible with no authentication required.

rate_limits.note: No hard rate limits are currently enforced, but please be respectful of usage.
